_설명: 심화 9과 접속사 — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다.

문항.prompt: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
body: ________ the girl heard the news, she started
to smile.
그 소녀는 그 소식을 듣자마자, 웃기 시작했다.
choices: Because
Since
As soon as
As
For

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영어로 옮길 때 빈칸에 알맞은 것은?
body: 나는 형이 돌아올 때까지 기다려야 한다.
→ I have to wait _________ my brother comes
back.
choices: by
until
before
after
when
문항.explanation: 어떤 때까지 이어지는 일이므로 until을 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 대신할 수 있는것은?
body: Many flights were canceled [[because of]] the
heavy fog.
choices: because
the reason
due to
thanks for
in that
문항.explanation: 뒤에 명사구가 오므로 전치사구인 due to로 바꿔 쓸 수 있다.

문항.포인트: B as well as A의 수일치
문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 가장 정확하게 영작한 것은?
body: 그의 형들뿐만 아니라 그도 역시 그 규칙을 지켜야
합니다.
choices: He as well as his brothers has to follow the rules.
He as well as his brothers have to follow the rules.
His brothers as well as he has to follow the rules.
Not only he but also his brothers has to follow rules.
Not only his brothers but also he have to follow the rules.
문항.explanation: 「B as well as A」는 B에 동사를 맞추므로 He에 맞춰 has를 쓴다.

body: Despite the heavy rain, she walked to school
every day.
choices: Since it rained heavily, she walked to school every day.
As though it rained heavily, she walked to school every day.
She walked to school every day though it rained heavily.
Unless it rained heavily, she walked to school every day.
She walked to school every day because it rained heavily.
문항.explanation: Despite는 ‘~에도 불구하고’라는 뜻이므로 접속사 though로 바꿔 쓴다.

body: I couldn't go outside yesterday because ____________.
choices: heavy rain
it snowed a lot
I had a high fever
I had many things to finish
it was too dark and cold outside
문항.explanation: because 뒤에는 절이 와야 하므로 명사구만 오면 because of로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장의 밑줄 친 [[that]]과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
body: The students [[that]] had no books are now writers
and are sharing their stories.
choices: [[That']]s mine.
It's not [[that]] far today.
The hat [[that]] he is wearing is new.
Remember [[that]] you should be honest.
It is very lucky [[that]] he found the ring.
문항.explanation: <보기>와 ③의 that은 앞의 명사를 꾸미는 관계대명사이다.

choices: I can wear anything _____ it isn't too tight.
You may play here _____ you are careful.
You won't fail _____ you keep trying.
I will swim every day _____ I am healthy.
I'll stay here _____ you call me.
문항.explanation: ①~④는 ‘~하는 한’이라는 as long as, ⑤는 ‘~할 때까지’라는 until이 들어간다.

choices: ________ they are busy, they are not tired.
I didn't stop ________ it was painful.
I couldn't finish it ________ I tried very hard.
________ I left early, I caught the bus.
________ it was raining, they kept playing.
문항.explanation: ④만 ‘~때문에’라는 이유를 나타내고 나머지는 ‘~이지만’이라는 양보를 나타낸다.

문항.prompt: 어법상 빈칸에 들어갈 가장 알맞은 것은?
body: When she _________ home tomorrow, I will show
her the gift.
choices: come
comes
came
will come
has come
문항.explanation: 때를 나타내는 절에서는 미래의 일이라도 현재시제로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 것 중 뜻이 [[다른]]하나는?
choices: I've met him [[once]].
[[Once]] he starts a book, he reads it to the end.
[[Once]] the light was off, the children got quiet.
[[Once]] they heard the song, they wanted to sing it.
[[Once]] you taste it, you will love it.

body: <보기>
▪ I waited at the gate __________ the rain stopped.
▪ Stay here __________ I finish my work.
choices: because
until
as long as
while
once
문항.explanation: 두 문장 모두 어떤 때까지 이어지는 일을 나타내므로 until을 쓴다.

문항.포인트: once와 as long as의 뜻 차이
문항.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 [[어색한]]문장을고르세요.
choices: You may borrow it [[once]] you return it soon.
[[Once]] you start, you can't stop.
Go straight [[until]] you see the bridge.
The score doesn't matter [[as long as]] you enjoyed it.
I don't mind where you sit [[as long as]] you are quiet.
문항.explanation: 조건을 붙이는 자리이므로 ‘~하는 한’이라는 뜻의 as long as로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 문장 안에서의 역할이 [[다]] [[른]]것은?
choices: The point is [[that I still trust her.]]
I know [[that we should keep the rules.]]
My wish was [[that I would meet the writer.]]
The reason is [[that I lost the key]].
The problem was [[that he had no time.]]
문항.explanation: ②만 동사의 목적어이고 나머지는 be동사 뒤의 보어이다.
